question: Which of the following is an example of a flow variable?

options.text: Amount of capital goods employed in an economy on the first day of its financial year.
Money supply in a country on the first day of its financial year.
Export of food grains in a particular financial year.
Amount of food grains available in all warehouses of the country on the first day of its financial year.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Export of food grains in a particular financial year.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A flow is a quantity that is measured with **reference to a period of time.**
 
• Thus, flows are defined with **reference to a specific period (length of time)**.
 
• It has a time dimension.
 
• **National income** is a flow.
 
• It describes and **measures flow of goods and services which become available to a country during a year.**
 
 
• Hence** ****Export of food grains in a particular financial year** is an example of a flow variable.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Stocks are defined at a particular point in time.

 
 
• So,__ **Wealth **is a stock variable as it can be measured at a particular time. 
 
 
 
• A flow shows change during a period of time whereas a stock indicates the quantity of a variable at a point of time.
 
• Wealth is a stock since it can be measured at a point of time.
 
• Income is a flow because it can be measured over a period of time.
 
• Salary and change in wealth is a flow because it can be measured over a period of time.
